text: dsh-slash-new 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话管理插件，通过 bundle 注册 /new 命令，并由客户端监听命令完成事件，在当前工作区打开一个空白会话。它会尝试沿用旧会话的代理预设和可表达为预设的权限设置；旧会话仍保留在列表中。适合希望快速开始新对话、同时保持会话预设的 DSH 用户。

dsh-slash-new adds /new for the DSH Web client. It opens a blank session in the current workspace and keeps the previous session available. The command carries over the old agent preset and supported permission preset, so users can start fresh without restoring those settings manually.
想在当前工作区快速开启一个空白 DSH 会话。
新建对话时，能不能继续使用原来的代理和权限预设？
Start a fresh DSH session in the same workspace while keeping the existing presets.
dsh-slash-new 的功能「用 /new 开启空白会话」：在 DSH 中输入 /new 后，客户端会在当前工作区创建或连接空白会话，并将其打开；旧会话仍保留。
dsh-slash-new 的功能「沿用会话预设」：开启新会话时会传递旧会话的代理预设，并尝试通过宿主的 /permission 命令恢复可继承的权限预设；自定义权限组合无法作为预设继承。

A small [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) (DSH) plugin that adds a single slash command: **`/new`**.

dsh-slash-new README · dsh-slash-new：It starts a blank session in the current workspace — the same action as the sidebar's 「新会话」 button and `Cmd+N` — and carries the old session's **permission preset** and **agent preset** over to the new one, so starting fresh never silently widens or narrows what the agent is allowed to do.

dsh-slash-new README · Why it exists：DSH sessions are append-only logs, so there is nothing to truncate in place. "Clearing" a conversation means starting a new one and leaving the old log in the sidebar. DSH ships `/compact`, but no `/new` in the desktop composer, and hand-creating a session resets its permission preset to the profile default.

dsh-slash-new README · What `/new` does：| Step | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Reads the current session's `permissions` projection (`read-only` / `ask` / `never` / `danger-full-access` / `auto`) and its `agentPreset` |
| 2 | Creates or reuses a blank session in the **same workspace**, passing the agent preset to session creation |
| 3 | Opens that session in the main panel |
| 4 | Replays the permission preset by running the host's own `/permission <preset>` command in the new session — the same call the permission chip in the composer makes |

dsh-slash-new README · What `/new` does：The previous session keeps its log and stays in the sidebar. A *custom* (hand-tuned) permission mix cannot be expressed as a preset, so the new session falls back to the host default and a warning is logged to the client console.

dsh-slash-new README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-slash-new
```

…then drop `"dsh-slash-new"` from `dsh.bundle.bundles` and restart.

dsh-slash-new README · Compatibility：- Tested with DSH desktop `0.2.1-rc.3` (Web renderer). The client half needs `sessions`, `workspaces` and `uiWorkspace` (blank-session creation, session switching) and the host's `/permission` command.
- Do not install it alongside another plugin that owns `/new` (for example `deepseek-harness-ultra-slash`): both register the same command name and both listen to `command/executed`, so a single `/new` would switch sessions twice.

dsh-slash-new README · Development：```sh
node --test test/*.test.mjs   # unit tests (no dependencies, Node >= 20)
node --check lib/index.js && node --check client/client.js
```

- `lib/index.js` — host half: registers the command in `ctx.commands` and settles a short result.
- `client/client.js` — browser half: listens to `command/executed`, opens the blank session and replays the preset.
- `test/` — fake-context tests for both halves, including the inherited-preset and custom-preset paths.

dsh-slash-new README · Development：For an end-to-end check without touching your real profile, boot a disposable instance and run `/new` there:

```sh
DSH_HOME=/tmp/dshhome dsh --profile scratch --no-open --port 63002
```

dsh-slash-new README · 中文速览：`/new` 在 DSH 桌面端开启一个空白会话（等同于侧边栏「新会话」/`Cmd+N`），并把当前会话的**权限预设**和**代理预设**带到新会话里，避免一开新会话权限就被重置成默认值。旧会话的日志仍留在左侧列表。自定义（custom）权限无法用预设表达，新会话会回落到默认并在控制台告警。
